reason: The cited evidence (E1) demonstrates the concept in an AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA, not a refractory HEA, so the key premise that this processing works for refractory HEAs is unsupported. The mechanisms of hierarchical constraint and crack-arresting are described in E1, but their transferability to refractory systems is assumed without evidence.
premises: Tailored thermo-mechanical processing can induce a duplex lamellar microstructure in refractory HEAs
A duplex lamellar microstructure acts as an in situ composite with hierarchical constraint
Phase boundaries in the duplex structure impede dislocations (strength) and arrest cracks (ductility)
This microstructural design overcomes the strength–ductility trade-off relative to single-phase alloys
